analyst.summary: Tega Industries makes mill liners and other wear parts for the mining industry - a recurring, replacement-driven consumables business with a real competitive position (second-largest globally). However, profit growth has actually gone backwards over the last three years even as revenue ticked up, and margins in the latest quarter (11% operating margin) are well below the company's historical levels. At roughly 83x trailing earnings, we don't think the current valuation is justified until the margin trend actually turns, so we rate it a Hold.
